1.

I belong to heaven’s free children, for Jesus has made me free From Satan’s bonds and the law’s judgment and sin’s slavery; And since He, out of pure grace, has loosed my poor soul, I will be a “freeman of the Lord” and no man’s slave.

2.

What wonder, if my longing now ever more stretches forth, My Lord and my Saviour, upward, upward to Thee! My origin is, O God, from Thee, and I am a stranger here, In heaven is my citizenship, and there I am at home.

3.

Now I may stand in the same grace that sought and found me, And trust in His faithfulness who allowed Himself to be offered. In Him I am white and clean, righteous, holy, acceptable, As surely as the Father sees no spot in the Son.
